rules.blank: Blank measures become NULL and remain distinct from recorded zero.
rules.scope: Personnel measures cover public schools only. A populated measure outside Public is quarantined.
rules.enrollment_outlier: A populated personnel measure greater than total same-year enrollment quarantines the school row from derived staffing measures.
rules.principal_total: The publisher total is retained. A separate calculated total and discrepancy flag are added.
rules.all_blank: The published all-blank measure is retained and explicitly flagged as unavailable.
